title: Cute - get them.
text: Cute - get them.. So cute! I'm in love with these. They are hanging In my kitchen above the sink and changes the whole look of the room. Also, you can see the pattern from the back outside but you can't see through them. The material is soft and smooth - not crunchy.

product_metadata.title: DriftAway Bella Medallion Pattern Kitchen Tier Rod Pocket Window Curtain Set of 2 Each Size 29 Inch by 24 Inch Plus 2 Inch Header Aqua and Gray
features: PACKAGE INCLUDES: 2 kitchen tiers, made of 100% polyester, imported.

DESIGN AND STYLE: Bella kitchen tiers have a modern aesthetic and feature a coastal medallion print. The design is untraditional unlike others, inspired by Bohemian style. Those delicate patterns will enliven your kitchen or room immediately. The Bella versatile kitchen tiers provide an easy way to add color and style to your home.

UPGRADED VERSION: These kitchen tiers innovated by thick fabric, will help reduce outside noise and provide privacy properly, as well as prevent harmful UV rays from reaching your floors and furniture, efficiently prevents cold or heat transfer from outside, increasing the energy efficiency of your home. Our fabric is 100% none chemical smell and feels extremely soft and smooth to touch
SIZE AND HEADER TYPE: 29’’W x 24’’L each, plus 2" header. Rod pocket slides easily onto curtain rod for quick installation
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Machine wash cold separately, gentle cycle, only non-chlorine bleach when needed, tumble dry low, cool iron if needed.
